name: MeshHub Bot
description: MeshCore companion bot for openHop Repeater with Autoresponder, US NWS Weather & Alerts, Radio Nets, and MeshWars.

net_bot.opening_message: Weekly Net is now OPEN! Send {keyword} to check in.
net_bot.closing_message: Weekly Net is now CLOSED. Total check-ins: {count}. Thank you for participating!
net_bot.reminder_1pm_message: Reminder: Weekly Net tonight at {time} on {channel}! Send {keyword} to check in.
net_bot.reminder_30m_message: Weekly Net starts in 30 minutes on {channel}! Send {keyword} when the net opens.

meshwars_bot.opening_message: Welcome to the MeshWars net! Send !checkin or any chat message to participate.
meshwars_bot.hourly_message: Register on https://meshwars.com and any message sent in this chat counts toward your bonus points.
meshwars_bot.halfway_message: MeshWars Net Update: Halfway through tonight's net! {count} {user_str} checked in so far.
meshwars_bot.final_hour_message: MeshWars Net Update: 1 hour remaining in tonight's net! {count} {user_str} checked in so far.
meshwars_bot.closing_message: The MeshWars net has concluded. Thank you for participating! {count} {user_str} checked in today.
meshwars_bot.reminder_1pm_message: Reminder: MeshWars Net starts today at {time} on {channel}!
meshwars_bot.reminder_30m_message: MeshWars Net starts in 30 minutes on {channel}! Get your nodes ready.
